fields.System.Title: FDN-605 — Bulk import products
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a system administrator going live, I want to load the product catalogue from a file,
so that thousands of products exist without manual entry.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a valid file, when I import it, then every product and its barcodes are
  • created.
  • - Given a file with any invalid row, then nothing is imported and every problem is
  • reported at once with row numbers.
  • - Given duplicate barcodes within the file or against the existing catalogue, then they
  • are reported as invalid.
  • - Given a weight or dimension outside a plausible range, then it is reported — a
  • 4,200 kg carton is a unit error, not a product.
  • - Given a case quantity of zero or blank, then it is reported as invalid.
  • - Given rows with similar descriptions, then they are reported as possible duplicates
  • without blocking the import.
  • - Given the same file imported twice, then the second import changes nothing.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | masterdata |
| Tables | product, product_barcode |
| Risks | Partial import ([doc 09 §11.4](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); duplicates ([doc 03 §7.5](../../../docs/03-master-data.md)); mixed units ([doc 08 §8](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · idempotency |
